metadata_scope: Controlled benchmark assumptions only, never official instrument or operating metadata
negative_label: Unmodified historical control; no injected anomaly, not independently certified fault-free
metric_unit: One detector decision per paired historical window; abstained positives count as missed injections; abstained negatives excluded from FPR denominator and reported separately
latency_unit: Source-clock hours from injected pattern onset, conditional on detection; not wall-clock API or live delivery latency
